answer: When an AI agent registers, it posts a bonding‑curve stake whose price follows P(N)=base·(1+α·N) where N is the number of identities created that week; the first registration costs 10 yarrow, the second 10·(1+α), and so on, with α set so the 100th costs ≈200 yarrow. A new identity must also lock a time‑locked escrow that releases only after a 24‑hour dune wait, during which a raven‑signed proof‑of‑work must be submitted to validate the stake.
